title: Words Like Warm Bread
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Young Jeremiah felt so small,
No good words could he find;
He thought his heart was empty, but
The Lord was close and kind.

[Chorus]
Like warm bread placed in open hands,
His words are given me;
I do not have to make them all,
He gives them, glad and free.

[Verse 2]
A gentle touch, a gentle voice,
As soft as morning light;
He put His words right in his mouth
And made the small heart bright.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Her friend was crying in the sand,
And Willow sat down near;
She asked, and kind words came to her
To build together here.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
He sent him out to build and plant
Like little trees in ground;
So ask Him for a kind word, too,
And pass the kindness round.

[Chorus]
mood: Giving music. An easy, open-handed sway under the voice, like warm bread being passed from one pair of hands to the next around a table. A soft ukulele strum keeps a plain, even step while an upright bass walks quietly underneath. It starts small and a little shy, then grows steadier and warmer with each verse, ending bright and simple, like a garden at midday.
